name: money-mitra
description: Runs the Money Mitra client and server together for local development

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
